🟢 Open Access

Basic Track

Welcome to the **Basic Track** of the R Data Visualization Workshop — an open-access, self-paced learning platform for data wrangling, visualization, and statistical analysis in R. This site contains hands-on examples, best practices, and plotting techniques all in one place.

## 🎯 Workshop Goals - Learn the basics of good data visualization - Use R to wrangle and prepare data - Explore basic visualization and statistical testing - Create reproducible reports using Quarto ## 📚 What This Track Covers - 📁 R Foundations & Data Wrangling - 📊 Basic Visualization with ggplot2 - 🧪 Statistical Test Selection - 📈 ggstatsplot — Introduction - 📝 Quarto Basics ## 🧭 Find Your Way Around Use the navigation bar above to browse all modules. Key starting points: - 📁 **[R Foundations](r-foundations/getting-started.qmd)** — R syntax, data cleaning, and tidy workflows - 📊 **[Data Visualization](data-visualization/ggplot_grammar.qmd)** — Grammar of graphics and basic ggplot2 - 🧪 **[Statistical Analysis](statistical-analysis/statistical_tests.qmd)** — Choosing the right statistical test - 📝 **[Reproducibility](statistical-analysis/reproducible_writing.qmd)** — Creating reports with Quarto > Use the navbar above to explore topics in any order. ## 📥 Downloadable Resources All files for this track are available below, grouped by type. ### 📄 R Scripts - [Basic r Foundations](downloads/basic_r_foundations.R) - [Basic Visualization](downloads/basic_visualization.R) ### 🗄️ Datasets - 📊 [Workshop Data](downloads/workshop_data.csv) `.csv` - 📗 [Workshop Data](downloads/workshop_data.xlsx) `.xlsx` - 🔵 [Workshop Data](downloads/workshop_data.rds) `.rds` ### 📋 Cheatsheets - [ggplot2 Cheatsheet](downloads/ggplot2_cheatsheet.pdf) - [Dplyr Cheatsheet](downloads/dplyr_cheatsheet.pdf) ### 📝 Quarto Template - [Quarto Basics](downloads/quarto_basics.qmd) — starter `.qmd` file covering Quarto basics --- > 💡 **Tip:** New to R? Start with **R Foundations → Getting Started** before anything else.
